create_mae_model: create a MAE model with a ViT encoder, decoder dimensions, and masking ratio for self-supervised pretraining
train_mae_reconstruction: train a MAE model to reconstruct masked image patches using MSE loss on pixel values
forward_mae_inference: run a forward pass of the MAE model on image tensors to compute reconstruction loss
configure_mae_masking: configure the MAE model with a custom masking ratio to control the fraction of patches hidden during training
build_mae_decoder: build a MAE decoder with configurable depth, heads, and dimension to reconstruct masked image tokens
